policy.platformVerified: Only interfaceLanguages entries with verified_* labels are verified platform language facts. Observed subsets are lower bounds, not exhaustive lists.
policy.regionalSupplement: For unverified platforms use selected market main language, label 地区补充, and keep brand names/model codes untranslated. Do not assert platform interface support.
policy.queryGeneration: Generate language-specific query variants using locally translated commerce/dealer/authorization terms. Scope each variant to selected platform domain AND market. UI hl alone is not multilingual query generation.
policy.globalPlatforms: Global multilingual interfaces do not require sending all 17 languages to every market; intersect market-relevant language(s) with verified available variants, adding selected regional supplements separately.
policy.variants: Preserve zh-Hant versus zh-Hans, and country flags separate from language code.
